primary_method: standardized centroids with fixed per-route majority aggregation
ideal_method: same calibration identities and centroid rule, fitted on exact noiseless features
paired_test: two-sided exact McNemar; descriptive, not an equivalence test

reported_sensitivity.evidence_type: reported aggregate, not recomputed from public outcome records

data_scope: Anonymized derived predictions and aggregate references. IDs and order do not encode source-image identity or execution order. No input images, measurement counts, features or fitted parameters are distributed.
